recipe.visualDefinition: A surrealistic portrait of a man with a 1960s bowl-cut hairstyle, where the face is integrated with intricate, swirling line-art patterns and mechanical filigree. The image uses a high-contrast monochromatic purple and black palette against a stark white background, framed by a thick black border and a top-aligned typographic banner.
coreVisualRelationships: The organic hair shape acts as a heavy frame for the detailed facial features.
The intricate line art on the cheek contrasts with the smooth photographic shading of the nose and mouth.
The bold, flat color of the header text balances the complex textures of the central portrait.
coreInvariants: Monochromatic purple tinting on the subject.
Intricate, hand-drawn filigree patterns overlaid on facial anatomy.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered portrait, large scale, filling the majority of the inner white square.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes, particularly the right eye framed by a monocle-like circular pattern.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bold top banner down to the eyes, then following the swirling patterns across the cheek to the chin.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Stark white background within the black frame, isolating the head shape.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep purple and magenta tones for the subject and text.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the background and banner strip.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Solid black for the outer frame and specific typographic elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white background and the dark, saturated purple subject.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to purple, magenta, black, and white.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are tightly packed to create a solid block of color.

composition.relationshipToImage: Contained within a white rectangular strip at the top.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a wide, bold magenta font and a narrower, black condensed font for emphasis.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and condensed nature of the primary text.
Provides the necessary grotesque structure and tight spacing.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a monochromatic purple portrait of a man with 1960s hair, featuring intricate black line-art filigree and swirls on his face, set against a white background inside a thick black square frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a white horizontal bar at the top containing extra-bold, condensed magenta and black sans-serif text in all caps, tightly spaced.

verificationChecks: Are the filigree patterns integrated into the facial features?
Is the text contained in a distinct top banner?
Is there a thick black border around the entire composition?

mustRedesign: Specific facial identity of the subject
Exact wording of the original text

mustAchieve: Intricate, fine-line detail in the filigree

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the line art doesn't obscure the facial recognition entirely.
Verify the magenta text is legible against the white banner.
Check that the black frame is perfectly symmetrical.
Confirm the hair texture maintains a graphic, illustrative quality.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject Portrait] with [Intricate Line Art Overlays] + [Monochromatic Tint] + [Bold Condensed Header Banner] + [Thick Black Frame].
